name: Gem Fire Fortune

features.name: Multiplied free spins
features.description: Every bonus win carries a 5x, 10x or 100x multiplier.

review:
Gem Fire Fortune is a cluster slot where groups of five to 13 or more matching gems pay up to 35x in the base game. Any winning combination can randomly receive a 2x, 5x, 10x or 100x multiplier.

Three or more scatters award 10 free spins, and three more during the round add five spins. In the bonus, every winning combination is certain to carry a 5x, 10x or 100x multiplier, a big step up from the base game. The in-game screens advertise up to 15,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. Simple to follow, with a lot of upside in the bonus.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
